licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (quell' iniqua and quest' alma as two words each; troppo oh Dio without commas; the dots printed after consigliarmi, iniqua and cancellarla given as one ellipsis each).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 275–279, bars 1–103 of No. 27
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung line and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, recitative and cavatina), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. The accompanied recitative is bars 1–29 (Allegro; Andante from bar 25, printed over the second half of bar 24). The Cavatina starts with a one-eighth upbeat at bar 30, set as 1/8, then Allegro in ¢ (alla breve) with three flats, in C major from bar 68. Playback tempo: the recitative at ♩ = 72, its Andante at ♩ = 60 (Jacobs 1:35), the Cavatina at ♩ = 125, estimated from Jacobs (6:08, which also includes the next recitatives); Mozart gives the words only.
